queries:
SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_diff
FROM (
    SELECT ID, AVG(PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(TAT - TAT2) AS avg_diff
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT AVG(a) - AVG(b) FROM (SELECT ID, AVG(TAT) AS a, AVG(TAT2) AS b FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID)

SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_diff
FROM (
    SELECT ID, AVG(PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(TAT - TAT2) AS avg_diff
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING AVG(PT) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(TAT - TAT2) IS NOT NULL
);

SELECT AVG(avg_pt), AVG(diff)
FROM (
  SELECT ID, AVG(PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(TAT) - AVG(TAT2) AS diff
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
  HAVING AVG(PT) IS NOT NULL AND (AVG(TAT) - AVG(TAT2)) IS NOT NULL
)
